verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.reflection: Where could you make a little room for rest today?

verses.text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.reflection: What would it look like to meet this day with quiet confidence?

verses.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.reflection: What are you carrying that you could bring to God in prayer?

verses.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.reflection: What helps you hold on to hope in a season of uncertainty?

verses.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.reflection: Name one uncertainty you can bring to God today.

verses.text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.reflection: What is the next small, faithful step before you?

verses.text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.reflection: Pause and name one ordinary gift you are grateful for.

verses.text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.reflection: Who could use a little care from you today?

verses.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.reflection: Where do you need wisdom in your life today?

plans.title: A quiet beginning
plans.sub: Five passages to make room for God.

plans.title: Peace for anxious hearts
plans.sub: A little room to rest and trust.

plainReadings.Genesis 1:1: The opening verse says that God created the heavens and the earth.
plainReadings.Genesis 1:2: The earth is described as unformed and empty, with darkness over the deep and God’s Spirit moving over the waters.
plainReadings.Genesis 1:3: God speaks, calling for light, and light appears.
plainReadings.ps23: The speaker trusts the Lord to care for and guide him, as a shepherd cares for a flock.
plainReadings.pr31: She is described as strong and honourable, facing the future with joy.
plainReadings.mt11: Jesus invites people who are weary and burdened to come to him for rest.
plainReadings.jr29: The Lord speaks of peaceful intentions and a hopeful future for the people being addressed.
plainReadings.pr3: Trust the Lord wholeheartedly rather than depending only on your own understanding.
plainReadings.ps119: God’s word is compared to a lamp that helps someone see where to walk.
plainReadings.ps107: Give thanks to the Lord for his goodness and enduring mercy.
plainReadings.pr17: A friend continues to love, including during difficult times.
plainReadings.jm1: Someone who lacks wisdom is invited to ask God, who gives generously.
